The essence of true hospitality
The greatness of simplicity. The good life. You can find it all at the Ansitz Steinbock in Villanders/Villandro in your home-from-home, together with people who bring cheer to your days and evenings with a smile. In the comfort of the wood-panelled “Stube” parlours where drinking and dining have taken on the status of art form, and in the suites where the minimalist simplicity is a language spoken with clarity.
Conscientious, grounded and attentive. We see ourselves as the proud custodians of history and, with our finely honed sensitivity for the precious and the rare, have created a place of beauty for you to spend your time here with us. By approaching each individual at eye-to-eye level, preferably on first-name terms, but always with respect and sensitivity, we foster a natural connection of an authentic warmth that transforms a guest house into a house of friends, for friends.
Timeless design within ancient walls. Great architecture on a small scale
One-off pieces
Less is more. The bold renovations have created an exclusive ambience. Just 12 suites, each more beautiful than the other, are the embodiment of comfort and contemporary luxury within historic walls.
Choose your favourite suite
New ranks in the Steinbock kitchen!
Dining at the Steinbock
The three restaurant concepts are still here, as ever—it’s the kitchen management that’s changed: since October 2024, René Tschager has been shaping the Steinbock cuisine with his own youthful signature. Born and bred in South Tyrol, René takes a fascinating approach to the culinary arts: easy-going and carefree, but, in equal measure, respectful of ingredients and the finest of gourmet cuisine.
Your palate was made to be happy
La Lumosa
Fine Dining: Minimalist and meticulous
Stain à la carte
Well-planned lunch and evening menu
Steinbock classic
A 5-course Alpine dinner for hotel guests
One hotel, one team, so many personalities.
Let’s be friends.
The hosts
An evening is about so much more than just good food and drink. The soul dances, the heart leaps, and the smile stays on your face until you fall asleep. We put our all into providing just that.
About us
Indivisibly linked with the history of the village.
When tradition becomes heartfelt appreciation.
History and architecture
Initially a courthouse, the Steinbock went on to become a hotel in later years. The Ansitz Steinbock is deeply rooted in the Villandro village chronicles. The castle-like manor has always been an institution, and remains so to this day.
Preserve the old, embrace the new
Experiences in the surrounding area
Sights to see, just around the corner.
Surroundings
Villandro is located in the very heart of South Tyrol, and is the perfect base to explore the wineries, architecture and natural beauty of the surrounding area.

12 One-off pieces
Uncompromising and decisive: Minimalist simplicity, speaking a beautifully articulated language. Architecture and interior design have been brought together with the finest of sensitivity, and historic walls blend harmoniously with contemporary style and local craftsmanship. Are you a design connoisseur? An individualist and an aesthete? Then you’ll take great pleasure in this stylish selection.
